NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT APPLICATION

Applicant: Here to Stay CLT, Inc.
Property Location: 3724 W. LeMoyne Street
Proposed Zoning: RM-S5 District
Lot Area: 3,130 SF
Here to Stay CLT, Inc. is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property
located at 3724 W. LeMoyne Street from the RS-3 District to the RM-5 District. The Applicant requests a re-
zoning from the RM-3 District to the RM-5 District to develop the property with a three-story building
containing six dwelling units with no parking spaces. The height of the building will be 33.50 feet. The subject
property is currently vacant.
NARRATIVE ZONING ANALYSIS
(a) Floor Area and Floor Area Ratio:
i. Lot area: 3,130 SF
ii. Total proposed building area: 6,918.39 SF
iii. Proposed FAR: 2.2
(b) Density (Lot Area Per Dwelling Unit): 522 SF
(c) Amount of off-street parking: None
(d) Setbacks:
e Front Setback: 6.0 FT
e Rear Setback: 6.0 FT
e Side Setback: 3.0 FT on east side (3.0 FT combined)
(e) Building height: 33.50 FT

(f) Off-street Loading: None
